From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com

Hi Alyssa — great to hear the team is aligned. Attached is a first-draft MAP and an acceptance-tests doc (see attachments). High-level summary below and a short proposed timeline. I kept items ownership-specific to avoid confusion.

Attachment: StepStone_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: eval-acceptance-tests.md (text)

Summary (proposed):
- Evaluation window: 2026-12-01 -> 2027-01-12 (6 weeks, includes a 3-day soak at the end)
- Success criteria (must meet all to be "accepted"):
  1) Latency: 95th percentile for 512-token generation under production-like traffic <= 220ms
  2) Throughput: sustained 60 reqs/min during peak 2-hr windows with <1% error rate
  3) Accuracy: domain intent match ≥ 92% on the StepStone clinical prompt set (evaluation harness included)
  4) Data controls: KV cache policy and logging validated against StepStone retention requirements; evidence in the audit log export
  5) Regression: no model-output regressions on the provided golden prompt set exceeding 5% error delta vs baseline
- Exit gates:
  A) Tech gate — infra and routing configured, smoke tests green (Redwood)
  B) Compliance gate — audit export and KMS verification (StepStone can confirm)
  C) Business gate — procurement signoff on SOW and billing terms (StepStone)

Ownership: Redwood handles runtime, monitoring, and test harness. StepStone to provide golden prompts, sample production traffic profile, and procurement deliverables.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal alignment call (30 minutes) — Mon 2026-11-23 or Tue 2026-11-24
2) Finalize MAP workbook and sign SOW by Fri 2026-11-27
3) Kick pilot 2026-12-01

If that looks OK I'll push a cleaned MAP workbook with cells for owners, acceptance thresholds, and test artifacts.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

--

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@stepstonehealth.com>, jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro — StepStone evaluation MAP kickoff

Raj — quick answers: happy to support independent verification. Proposed approach:
- Redwood will run the canonical eval and publish an immutable report (hash + S3 link) at test checkpoints (week 2, week 4, final).
- StepStone can run the same harness locally; we'll provide the container/image and the seed data (masked).
- Rollback sequence (automated + manual):
  1) Automated fallback to smaller-capacity variant if error rate > 1.5% in a 10-minute window
  2) Trigger alert + pause new production traffic; continue drain on-inflight and route to fallback model
  3) If issues persist >30 minutes, execute full cutover to baseline model and notify both teams.

We'll enumerate the exact runbook in the MAP workbook under "Rollback & Escalation". Ben, can you fill in the monitoring hooks and threshold alerts?

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

Adding monitoring detail — draft excerpt for MAP workbook:
- Metrics to capture: p50/p95/p99 latency, request success rate, model confidence histogram, token-per-request distribution, KV cache hit rate
- Alerts: p95 > 250ms for 5 minutes; error rate > 1% sustained over 5 minutes; regression delta > 5% on golden set at checkpoint
- Evidence exports: 24-hour rolling trace window + weekly audit export (CSV + JSON)

I'll add the Grafana panels and the Webhook playbooks in the workbook. Will also include a sample trace for the demo.

Ben Carter
SRE, Redwood Inference
